description:
Nothing in the web app calls DELETE /api/exercises/:id, and nothing would call the rename endpoint either: exercises are only ever created and shown in a picker. Two endpoints exist that no user can reach.

Add the screen that makes them reachable: list the library, rename, and remove, with the "this will remove N sets" confirmation the roadmap asks for. The server already archives rather than deletes when history exists, so the confirmation should say which of the two will happen. RULES 5: this is the read path the rename's write path needs to be finished.
title: Exercise library screen
